headline: Frontline Clashes Persist Across Weathered Expanse And Linn Of Mercy
war_summary: Combat remains fiercest across the central and northern sectors, where Weathered Expanse continues to see bitter base contests, logging three strategic shifts in the past two hours to leave three strongholds in neutral ruin. In Linn of Mercy, fierce localized fighting produced five fresh base transitions during the same two-hour span around Lathair and Outwich Ranch, maintaining steady pressure along the river line. Nevish Line, which recorded twenty-two base turnovers across the six-hour mark, has seen territorial exchanges halt in the latest two hours even as heavy fighting inflicted over two thousand combined casualties. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage experienced a sharp resurgence in attritional combat, absorbing eighteen hundred dead in two hours without shifting front lines. Former flashpoints in Stonecradle and Mooring County have settled into prolonged quiet with no recent base flips, while the broader rearward hexes remain entirely undisturbed by enemy action.
